Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The gnome-software packages contain an application that makes it easy to add, remove, and update software in the GNOME desktop. 

Gnome Software is a new way to install and manage software on the user's system. With Gnome Software, users can view installed GUI applications, remove installed applications, view available application updates, install available updates, find and install new applications, and find an application to handle a specific type of file. GNOME PackageKit remains to be the default updater for GNOME. 
For more information on Gnome Software, see the GNOME release
notes in the References section and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7.2 Release Notes.

This enhancement update adds the gnome-software packages to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7. (BZ#1184203) 

The gnome-packagekit and PackageKit packages have been upgraded to upstream version 3.14.2. and 1.0.6 respectively, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous versions. (BZ#1174550, BZ#1174728)

All users who require gnome-software are advised to install these new packages.
